_comment: Example pi-orchestrate policy. This file is never read or created automatically by gates.py: copy it manually to ~/.config/pi-orchestrate/projects/<sha256(root)[:20]>.json then adapt 'root' and 'required'. 'root' must be the real absolute path of the target jj/Git root (must match exactly, realpath included). 'required' is the list of mandatory commands in 'full' mode (each an argv array, run in the clean copy after the prek hooks); it must never be empty.
